text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has once again started,
and this
camp will be a critical part of
our preparations for
our showdown with
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I show Бива Хаяхидэ the data that I've

meticulously prepared. There's a vast
amount of
notes, covering everything
from her next race to
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing the volume of data, she realizes
the sheer
effort I used to gather it all
and begins worrying
about my health.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp will bring us
one step
closer to completing her
winning equation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
